issues.claim: M&Y International Financial Services - cited source https://www.myifs.net/about-our-firm as evidence for 193 Livingston Ave and (732) 640-5088
issues.problem: Opened the cited page: it confirms a New Brunswick, NJ tax/accounting practice but prints no street address and no phone number. There is no /contact-us page (HTTP 404). So the address and phone in the entry are not supported by the citation given.
issues.fix: Either cite a page that actually prints 193 Livingston Ave / 732-640-5088 (a map or directory listing) and change active_evidence to match, or downgrade the row to directory-only.

issues.claim: Barrood Agency - 'own website' cited as evidence for 46 Bayard St, Suite 212
issues.problem: barrood.com homepage says the agency has offices in New Brunswick and Somerset, but neither the homepage nor /contact prints a street address in text. The Bayard St suite is not confirmed by the cited source.
issues.fix: Keep the business (clearly a real multi-office NB agency, 80 years, insurance + surety) but relabel evidence as 'own website (New Brunswick office stated) + directory for street address' and re-cite.

issues.claim: Blinder Law - 'own website contact page' as evidence for 94 Church St, Suite 401B
issues.problem: Opened /contact-us: it confirms the firm and the corrected phone (848) 201-3667 but the page body carries no street address.
issues.fix: Add a source that prints 94 Church St (e.g. the firm's location/Google Business profile) or move the address to 'unverified'.

issues.claim: Benedict Altman and Nettl - address 247 Livingston Ave
issues.problem: The firm's own homepage and /directions and /contact-us pages confirm a New Brunswick criminal-defense firm at (732) 745-9000, but do not print the street address in readable text (map iframe only). The address rests entirely on the Super Lawyers profile.
issues.fix: Note in active_evidence that the address comes from the directory profile only; row itself is fine.

issues.claim: Brach Eichler Injury Lawyers (New Brunswick office) - phone (732) 352-9005, Suite 320
issues.problem: Opened njlawresults.com/contact: it lists '317 George Street, 3rd Floor, New Brunswick' as an office (existence confirmed) but publishes (973) 364-8300 as the contact number and does not mention Suite 320. The 732 number in the entry is unsourced on the firm's site.
issues.fix: Keep the row (office confirmed) but replace the phone with the firm's published number or mark it unverified; change 'Suite 320' to '3rd Floor'.

issues.claim: Low-confidence single-directory rows retained in the list: 107 How Lane Realty LLC (find-open.com), Thompson Appraisal Service (Yellow Pages South Amboy appraiser category), Cintron Firm LLC (no address), VensIT Corp (BBB category page), Lean-IT Solutions and Trellis Network Services (Cylex), IT Service Group (Clutch)
issues.problem: These rest on bulk directories that the mapper itself flags and could not be re-confirmed. Spot check: the 107 How Lane address is an industrial property (Ridgecut Road / NAI DiLeo-Bram leasing), not an evident brokerage office, and the Thompson Appraisal citation is a South Amboy category page. None of these is provably wrong, but none can be verified as an operating New Brunswick business.
issues.fix: Drop these rows before outreach or mark them 'unverified - directory only, confirm by phone' so the triage team does not spend time on dead listings.

issues.claim: BD Tax & Accounting Services - ordinary local tax practice
issues.problem: Its own homepage states it employs over 200 people in 14 countries. That is at odds with the 'small local shop' framing and hints at a multi-country network.
issues.fix: Confirm size/ownership before outreach; if it is part of a larger international network, apply the mapper's size rule the same way it was applied to Slalom/CBIZ.

issues.claim: Overmyer Insurance Agency (109 Church St) excluded from the list
issues.problem: The Middlesex County chamber directory lists it at 109 Church St, New Brunswick as an independent agency, and my insurance search surfaced that listing. The mapper excluded it saying its own site places it in Cranford.
issues.fix: No action required for the verdict (exclusion is defensible), but note it as a borderline case if the insurance category looks thin to the triage team.
